<image>
What is the person doing with the object in their hands?

A person's hands are holding a dark, rectangular object with a textured surface. The left hand grips the top-left corner while the right hand holds the bottom-right corner. The object is positioned in front of a large white sheet of paper that rests on a brown cardboard box. To the left of the box is a stack of clear plastic-wrapped items, and to the right is a blue plastic crate and a large paper bag. The hands appear to be manipulating or inspecting the object.

<image>
What is the person doing with the white shirt on the table?

A person's hands are positioned on a white t-shirt that is laid flat on a table. The left hand is placed on the lower-left side of the shirt, while the right hand is near the right sleeve. To the left of the shirt, there is a pile of crumpled white fabric. To the right of the shirt, there is a stack of neatly folded white shirts, a pink cylindrical object, a blue-handled tool, and a small white container with a red label. The person appears to be in the process of folding or organizing the shirt.

<image>
What is the person doing with the white fabric on the table?

A person's hands are positioned at the top-right of the table, holding and manipulating a white piece of fabric. The left hand is near the top edge of the fabric while the right hand is lower down, appearing to fold or adjust it. A large pile of crumpled white fabric occupies the left side of the table surface. A black rectangular object, likely a phone, rests on the table near the person's hands. The fabric being handled is separate from the main pile and is being worked on by the person's hands.

<image>
What is the person doing with the white garment on the table?

A person wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt is standing at a white table. Their right hand is holding the top edge of a white garment, while their left hand is positioned near the bottom right corner of the same garment. The garment is laid flat on the table surface. To the left of the garment, there is a large pile of crumpled white fabric. A black smartphone and a red object are placed on the table between the pile of fabric and the garment. In the background, stacks of folded white items are visible on shelves.

<image>
What is the person doing with the white fabric at the top of the table?

A person wearing a dark blue shirt is standing behind a large white table, holding a piece of white fabric with both hands. The left hand is positioned at the top-left corner of the fabric while the right hand is near the bottom-right corner. To the left of the table, there is a pile of crumpled white fabric, and a black rectangular object lies on the table surface. On the right side of the table, there is a large stack of neatly folded white garments, a pink cylindrical object, and a roll of tape on a small mat. A green-handled tool is placed near the bottom-right corner of the table.
